business_summary: Shanghai Tongji Science&Technology Industrial Co.,Ltd engages in the engineering supervision and consulting, construction engineering management, environmental engineering technology services and investment and construction, and real estate development in China. The company offers investment consulting, preliminary research and construction planning research, such as brand image planning, operation and management planning, urban and rural planning, architectural engineering design, and financial and tax consulting services. It also provides project management services, including engineering consulting, engineering supervision, project management, inspection and testing, cost consulting, and bidding agency. In addition, the company provides general contracting, municipal public works, and professional contracting services for industry, residential, environmental engineering, science and education, medical, commercial, environmental protection, ancient building maintenance, and municipal roads. Further, it engages in operations and maintenance business, including environmental protection operations, such as municipal sewage, industrial wastewater, sludge treatment and disposal, river dredging, landfill leachate treatment, waste gas treatment, and soil remediation; and industrial park operations, such as property management, asset management, business investment promotion, startup incubation, and public services for science and technology parks and industrial parks. Additionally, the company engages in real estate development, industrial investment, and fund investment. The company also provides digital business services, which includes BIM consulting, digital services, information consulting, and intelligent carbon integrated services. Shanghai Tongji Science&Technology Industrial Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanghai Tongji Science&Technology Industrial Co.,Ltd는 중국 내 엔지니어링 감독 및 컨설팅, 건설 엔지니어링 관리, 환경 엔지니어링 기술 서비스, 투자 및 건설, 부동산 개발 분야에 종사하고 있습니다. 브랜드 이미지 기획, 운영 및 관리 기획, 도시 및 농촌 계획, 건축 엔지니어링 설계, 재무 및 세무 컨설팅 서비스 등 투자 컨설팅, 예비 조사 및 건설 계획 연구를 제공합니다. 또한 엔지니어링 컨설팅, 엔지니어링 감독, 프로젝트 관리, 검사 및 테스트, 비용 컨설팅, 입찰 대행 등 프로젝트 관리 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 산업, 주거, ​​환경 공학, 과학 및 교육, 의료, 상업, 환경 보호, 고대 건물 유지 관리 및 지방 도로에 대한 일반 계약, 지방 공공 공사 및 전문 계약 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 생활하수, 산업폐수, 슬러지 처리 및 처리, 하천수 처리 등 환경보호 업무를 포함한 운영 및 유지관리 사업을 영위하고 있습니다.
